latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing with Français.

- Enables editing of video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) with automatic French subtitles or dubbing.
- Designed for French-speaking creators and educators to add French captions or translations.
- Fast cloud processing (1–2 minutes per video) with results delivered as 1080p MP4.
- Supports direct uploads, video editing commands, and session-based workflow.
- Includes credit management, export, and session state features within an integrated cloud render pipeline.
